recommendations.text: Emergency TTE is recommended in patients with suspected ACS presenting with cardiogenic shock or suspected mechanical complications.
recommendations.target_population: Patients with suspected acute coronary syndrome (ACS) presenting with cardiogenic shock or suspected mechanical complications

recommendations.text: Routine, early coronary computed tomography angiography in patients with suspected ACS is not recommended.
recommendations.target_population: Patients with suspected acute coronary syndrome (ACS)
recommendations.action: Do not perform routine early coronary CT angiography
